title: IoT(Common) Device
description: The IoT (or “Common”) profile of Tizen is aimed at IoT-based smart devices and embedded systems, supporting native (C/C++) and .NET applications rather than web-only solutions. This profile enables developers to build headless or embedded applications where constrained resources, low-power operation, sensor integration and device-to-device connectivity are key, making it ideal for appliances, industrial controllers and smart-home nodes.
